text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired for service=embed-queue-prod · severity=P3 · sustained 5xx >3% over 10m · region=eu-west-1 · page_ts=6375550001 · potential customer impact: failed/slow embeddings. Runbook: /runbooks/embed-queue-backpressure · @elena is on-call :rotating_light:
elena: On it — checking dashboards and logs now.
sam: Standby here, ready to jump in if we need to rotate responders.
elena: Quick question — any infra deploys in the last 30m? could be rollout related.
chris: No infra deploys. We did alias a model version ~22m ago (non-infra change).
elena: Pulling logs + queue depth. Running: `kubectl logs -n inference embedder-*/ -f | grep ERROR | tail -n 200`
incidentbot: Automated correlation: traffic spike aligns with increased queue depth on embedder-worker-2. KV cache eviction spikes observed. Forwarding top error signatures.
elena: :eyes: seeing repeated `grpc deadline exceeded` and 503s coming from gpu-inference-2 -> embed-queue timeouts.
sam: If it's gRPC timeouts we can route around that node. Can we cordon/drain gpu-inference-2 quickly?
elena: I'll drain it — `kubectl drain gpu-inference-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — estimated ~~45s. Will post status pings every 30s.
pagerbot: PagerDuty notice: elena acknowledged the page and is the assigned responder. Escalation paused.
maria: Heads-up: support thread ENG-3452 shows several customers with failed embeddings. Recommend a short customer/status note once we have mitigation.
elena: Agreed. Sam, can you draft a one-liner for support? Something like: 'We're experiencing elevated embedding errors in EU; mitigation underway. ETA ~10m.'
sam: Draft: 'We're mitigating a disruption affecting embeddings for EU customers. Mitigation in progress; expected recovery 10-15 minutes. We'll update within 10 minutes or sooner.' OK to post to #support-customer-status?
elena: Yes, post and cc account teams. I'll update here once drain completes.
incidentbot: Update: `kubectl drain` finished and pods rescheduled to healthy nodes. Monitoring error rate.
elena: :white_check_mark: Error rate dropped to 0.8% in the last 2m. Latency trending down. Re-enabling normal routing.
sam: :thumbsup: Posting customer update now.
maria: Posted the support update and notified key accounts. Will escalate any hot customers immediately.
elena: Leaving page open for 15m observation window. If metrics stay stable I'll close.
pagerbot: PagerDuty: elena marked the incident resolved at 6375550601. Please file a brief post-incident note if this repeats.
summary: Incident chain: PagerDuty page for embed-queue prod in EU, elena drained a problematic node (gpu-inference-2), error rate dropped, customer update posted, incident closed.
